2. `review-dry-run-end-40x20` now reaches the end. The scroll line reads "Lines 20-28 of 28, PgUp for earlier", the last item "(yours wins)" is visible, and the Apply (dry run), Back and Cancel actions are on screen. `review-dry-run-end-80x24` ends "Lines 5-19 of 19" with the actions visible. I did not read `review-dry-run-end-120x40`.
3. `review-failed-*` shows the recovery hint and actions at every saved size.
   - At 80x24, 40x20 and 120x40 it shows the cause, then "Fix the cause, then choose Back and review again, or choose Cancel and run holyagent setup later.", then "❯ Back" and "Cancel".

**Material:** none.

The heading "REVIEW (DRY RUN: WOULD CHANGE, NOTHING IS WRITTEN)" is wordy and wraps at 40 columns.
"(Apply (dry run))" and the result header both say dry run, which is mildly redundant.
